project_identity.description: Stable project identity, never inferred from a UI label.

command_lineage.description: Durable command identity preserved across waits and restarts.

objective_id.description: Bounded objective selected from current canonical truth.

write_scope.description: Normalized paths an execution may mutate.

resource_id.description: Stable execution or reasoning resource identity.

resource_class.description: Native, local reasoning, cloud reasoning, agentic, or browser class.

capability_requirements.description: Capabilities required by the task; not inferred from availability.

health_state.description: Service health independent of quota and lane eligibility.

session_id.description: External executor session identity; never canonical authority.

accepted_source_sha.description: Exact accepted source SHA after tests and remote CI.

runtime_slot.description: Activated slot identity; promotion is independent authority.

runtime_source_sha.description: Exact source SHA materialized into the runtime slot.
